info.name: Gemly Backend API - Complete Collection
info.description:
Complete API collection for Gemly Backend with all modules and endpoints synchronized with code. All values use proper constants from constants.utility.ts:

**User Types:** buyer, seller
**User Status:** PENDING_KYC, PENDING_ADMIN_APPROVAL, APPROVED, REJECTED, SUSPENDED

**Diamond Types:** Natural, Lab-Grown, Simulated
**Diamond Shapes:** Round, Princess, Emerald, Oval, Asscher, Marquise, Pear, Radiant, Cushion, Heart, etc.
**Cut Grades:** Ideal, Excellent, Very Good, Good, Fair, Poor
**Color Grades:** D-Z (Standard), or Fancy Color combinations
**Clarity Grades:** FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, SI1, SI2, SI3, I1, I2, I3
**Polish/Symmetry:** Excellent, Very Good, Good, Fair, Poor
**Fluorescence:** None, Faint, Medium, Strong, Very Strong
**Treatment Status:** Untreated, Treated, Any
**Certification Labs:** GIA, AGS, IGI, HRD, GCAL, EGL USA, etc.

**Currency:** USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, INR, JPY, CNY
**Payment Methods:** Wire Transfer, Credit Card, Bank Transfer, PayPal, Cryptocurrency, Check, Cash
**Stock Status:** In Stock, Can Source, Made to Order

**Requirement Status:** ACTIVE, EXPIRED, CLOSED, FULFILLED, CANCELLED
**Bid Status:** PENDING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, WITHDRAWN
**Deal Status:** DEAL_CREATED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED
**Escrow Status:** PENDING, HELD, RELEASED, REFUNDED, FAILED, CANCELLED, DISPUTED, EXPIRED

**Inventory Status:** IN_LOCKER, ON_MEMO, SOLD, IN_REPAIR, IN_TRANSIT, RETURNED, RESERVED, PENDING_CERTIFICATION
**Inventory Cut:** EXCELLENT, VERY_GOOD, GOOD, FAIR, POOR
**Inventory Color:** D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L, M
**Inventory Clarity:** FL, IF, VVS1, VVS2, VS1, VS2, SI1, SI2, I1
**Inventory Shape:** ROUND, PRINCESS, CUSHION, EMERALD, OVAL, RADIANT, ASSCHER, MARQUISE, HEART, PEAR
**Inventory Certificate:** GIA, IGI, AGS, HRD, EGL, NONE
**Deletion Reasons:** DAMAGED, LOST, STOLEN, RETURNED_TO_SUPPLIER, OTHER

**Ad Placements:** HOME_BANNER, SEARCH_SIDEBAR, LISTING_TOP, FOOTER
**Ad Status:** PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, EXPIRED

**Rating Abuse Reasons:** SPAM, PROFANITY, HARASSMENT, FALSE_INFORMATION, OFF_TOPIC, OTHER
**Notification Frequency:** Instant, Hourly Digest, Daily Digest, Weekly Digest
**Intended Use:** Engagement Ring, Wedding Band, Anniversary, Earrings, Necklace, Bracelet, Investment, Gift, Collection, Resale, Other
